notes: PROMOTED 2026-10-21 with the E026 registration commit (SPEC_SHA256 06d117ed…, skillset 8120c12e…). (LIVE_TESTS_COPY.md, E026; design not yet reviewed). Promote only after the challenger review, the freeze job, the spec fill (skillset_sha256, code_sha256, SPEC_SHA256 pin) and the ledger registration commit (>= 24 h before REGISTERED_UTC, LIVE_TESTS_COPY.md 2). Lane net (a 3-week cpu-lane job would block every cpu job); mem_mb 480 stays below the 500 MB blackout exemption. Disk: refuses above 1 GB in copy_skilled/. No retention rule may cover copy_skilled/ before the analysis is committed. Trade samples and captures are rotated by the nightly archive: the recorder must keep up (every 2 min tick; a sample is processed within minutes of completion). not_before = REGISTERED_UTC (2026-10-25T00:00:00Z): a collector must not exit 75 and burn its 48 tempfail attempts before the window opens. RE-PROMOTION RULE: if the queue marks this job `failed` (48 consecutive tempfails or an error), re-promote it within 48 h; trade samples are kept 3 days, so a longer gap loses those samples for good (the gap stays missing and is counted by sample_coverage; never backfilled). MEMORY (challenger R1 fix 5), measured 2026-10-21 on the Mac (macOS ru_maxrss, a FRESH child interpreter per target, Linux VmHWM not measurable there, so q0545 on the host should still be compared) on a synthetic store 7.3x the q0544 census (188,000 signal rows = 47,000 skilled + 141,000 controls over 250 files; 738,400 entry/exit rows over ~1,300 capture files; 57,393 resolutions; census: 2.88 d = 24,972 signals, 74,109 entries): recorder per-pass store reads + incremental pending list: 353 MB peak on a capture-only pass (6 captures of 30,000 markets, 9,980 pending items); 438-448 MB peak on a pass that also reads one trade sample of 240,000 wallet rows (the census mean is 239,000 rows per sample; 124,076 pending items) after the 150 MB import baseline. Before the fix (pending set rebuilt as millions of tuples per capture) the same pass peaked at 922 MB, which would have left the net lane exemption. mem_mb 480 leaves only ~9% over the worst measured pass: if q0545 on the host shows more than 490 MB, raise mem_mb (the job then leaves the exemption and counts against the cpu lane) rather than lowering the safeguard. as_cap_mb 4000 is the address-space (virtual) cap: numpy/pandas reserve far more virtual memory than they touch (a 2 GB cap broke the host backfill), and virtual size was NOT measurable on the Mac.
